title: Check advice against postflop golden spots on every test run
description:
As a learner, I want the postflop advice checked on every test run against curated spots with agreed answers, so that I can trust the postflop advice and its grades.

Golden-spot suite, part 2: at least 100 postflop spots across flop, turn and river, bringing the suite to at least 200, plus graded examples of each grade level. Clear-cut mechanically means call/fold spots at least 10 points from required equity and bet/check spots at least 15 points from 50% against the calling range. The suite runs in `npm test` and must pass 100%.

## Requirements covered
- REQ-037 (Must): Plain-English explanations — Every recommendation shall include an explanation of at most three sentences in plain English that names and briefly explains the poker concept behind it.
- REQ-038 (Must): Grading rules — The grader shall grade each user decision Correct when it matches the recommendation or a listed acceptable alternative, Major error when the margin rules below mark it clearly wrong, and Minor error otherwise.
- REQ-039 (Must): Golden spot suite — The project shall keep a golden-spot suite of at least 200 clear-cut decisions with justified recommended actions, and the automated test run shall fail if the advice engine disagrees with any of them.
- REQ-061 (Should): Legal and content — TLH Trainer shall use play money only and shall contain only strategy text and data written for this project.

Covers: REQ-037, REQ-038, REQ-039, REQ-061

Plan key: E07-S15 · Dream: limit-holdem-trainer

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given the golden-spot suite, When spots are counted, Then there are at least 100 postflop spots covering flop, turn and river and at least 200 spots in total [REQ-039.1]

Given a postflop call/fold spot within 10 points of required equity, or a bet/check spot within 15 points of 50% against the calling range, When the spot validator runs, Then it rejects the spot as not clear-cut [REQ-039.3]

Given the graded examples in the suite, When `npm test` runs, Then at least one preflop and one postflop example of each grade (Correct, Minor error, Major error) is graded as recorded [REQ-038.1, REQ-038.2, REQ-038.3, REQ-038.4]
Given every postflop golden spot, When its explanation is checked, Then it quotes the equity % and required equity % the recommendation returns [REQ-037.4]
Given the complete suite, When `npm test` runs, Then 100% of golden spots pass [REQ-039.4]
Given the golden spot suite, When it runs, Then it includes graded examples at Correct, Minor error and Major error, preflop and postflop, each asserting the exact grade, rule id and margin

Given preflop spot fr-btn-raise-88 (button holding 88 facing a hijack open, chart says call), When the spot set is extended, Then the chart cell is reviewed for call vs re-raise and the chart and spot agree on the chosen answer with a justification
Given preflop spot fr-hj-raise-and-calls-ajs, When its justification is revised, Then it no longer overstates how often the opener holds weaker aces (the claim is about the caller's range)

Given preflop spots fr-co-limpers-87s and fr-sb-unopened-65s (call cells whose suited neighbours fold), When the spot set is extended, Then each is replaced by a spot whose chart neighbours share its action, or the chart islands are reviewed and justified

No new network requests beyond the app's own files [REQ-058.1]

CI workflow is green on the story's branch (applies once the CI story E01-S02 is done; E01-S01 instead passes the same checks locally) [REQ-064.2]
